run_id.title: Run ID
run_id.description: Unique Apify actor run ID. Use to group all checks from the same run when trend-comparing weekly visibility scans.

platform.title: AI Platform
platform.description: AI search platform that generated this response. Values: 'perplexity', 'chatgpt', 'claude', 'gemini'. All run real-time web search — not static knowledge.

keyword.title: Keyword / Topic
keyword.description: The keyword or topic from your input that this query was generated for. Use this to group results by topic and identify per-keyword visibility gaps.

query.title: Query Submitted
query.description: The exact question submitted to the AI platform to probe whether your domain would be cited as a source for this topic.
query.example: What are the best resources and guides for learning about SEO?

query_template.title: Query Template
query_template.description: Template category that generated this query, or 'custom' if user-provided. Values: topic_authority, how_to, what_is, comparison, expert_picks, custom.

target_domain.title: Target Domain
target_domain.description: The domain being tracked for citations in this check. Normalized: no www., no https://.

domain_cited.title: Domain Cited
domain_cited.description: True if any URL from target_domain appears in the AI platform's cited sources for this query. This is the primary visibility signal — false means AI answered without crediting your site.

citation_rank.title: Citation Rank
citation_rank.description: 1-based position of the first target_domain URL in the AI's source list. 1 = your site is the primary source; higher numbers = less prominent. Null means the domain was not cited at all. Lower is better.

domain_citation_count.title: Domain Citation Count
domain_citation_count.description: Number of distinct URLs from target_domain that appeared in the AI's citations for this query. 0 = not cited; 2+ = multiple pages from your site were cited.

cited_page_url.title: First Cited Page URL
cited_page_url.description: The URL of the first page from target_domain that was cited in the AI's sources. Null if domain was not cited. Use this to identify which content is driving your AI search visibility.

cited_pages.title: All Cited Pages
cited_pages.description: All page URLs from target_domain that appeared in the AI's citation list for this query. Empty array if not cited. Multiple entries mean several of your pages were referenced as sources.

page_from_targets_cited.title: Target URL Cited
page_from_targets_cited.description: True if one of the user-specified targetUrls was cited in this response. Only meaningful when targetUrls was provided in input. False when no specific target pages were configured.

content_gap.title: Content Gap
content_gap.description: True when the AI cited sources for this query BUT none came from target_domain. This is an actionable signal: the AI is answering this topic using competitor content. False when no sources were cited (some platforms) or when the domain was cited.

total_sources_cited.title: Total Sources Cited
total_sources_cited.description: Total number of URLs cited by the AI in this response. Use with ai_coverage_ratio to understand how much of the source landscape your domain occupies. Zero when the platform returns no citations.

ai_coverage_ratio.title: AI Coverage Ratio
ai_coverage_ratio.description: Fraction of total cited sources that belong to target_domain. Range 0.0 to 1.0. E.g., 0.25 means 2 of 8 cited sources are from your domain. Zero if not cited.

competing_domains.title: Competing Domains
competing_domains.description: All other domains cited by the AI for this query (excluding target_domain). These are sites the AI treats as authoritative sources alongside or instead of yours. Use the top_competing_domains in the run summary to see which competitors appear most frequently across all checks.

ai_answer_excerpt.title: AI Answer Excerpt
ai_answer_excerpt.description: First 300–600 characters of the AI platform's response text (length depends on responseFormat input). Provides context for why your domain was or wasn't cited without storing the full response.
ai_answer_excerpt.example: When it comes to learning SEO, several resources stand out as particularly authoritative. Ahrefs Blog covers technical SEO, keyword research...

model_used.title: AI Model Used
model_used.description: The specific AI model version used for this check. Track model upgrades over time — visibility can change when platforms update their search models.

checked_at.title: Checked At
checked_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this visibility check was performed. Run the actor weekly and compare citation_rate and citation_rank trends over time to measure AEO progress.
